title: Pure Tindangle
summary: Tindangle cards only, with generic Fiend Links and staples. Tindangles are DARK Fiend Flip monsters that set themselves face-down and flip for value. Tindangle Intruder searches a Tindangle when flipped and comes back from the GY face-down whenever a monster is summoned face-down. Tindangle Base Gardna summons itself next to a face-down monster and swaps itself for another Tindangle when their Link points at a summon. The 2021 cards lead. Tindangle Jhrelth summons itself face-down by discarding and fetches a Flip monster, and Tindangle Dholes revives a Tindangle face-down when milled. Three Tindangles make Tindangle Acute Cerberus, which gains 3000 ATK once three different Tindangles, including Base Gardna, are in the GY. Gergonne's End protects Cerberus and destroys the monsters it points to, once all those zones are filled, for burn. Euler's Circuit stops attacks while you control three Tindangles.
